metric_notes.winner_accuracy: share of games where projected straight-up winner matched actual winner
metric_notes.ats_record: Project Gridiron side versus archived Project Gridiron consensus close; no pre-kickoff snapshot means no grade
metric_notes.ou_record: Project Gridiron O/U lean versus archived Project Gridiron consensus close; no pre-kickoff snapshot means no grade
metric_notes.market_source: The Odds API current NCAAF feed; median across available US books; final strictly pre-kickoff snapshot is official close
metric_notes.margin_mae: mean absolute error of projected home margin versus actual home margin
metric_notes.total_mae: mean absolute error of projected total versus actual total
metric_notes.scope: core performance ledger grades FBS-vs-FBS predictions only; FBS-vs-FCS projections are projection-only
